items.question: How do live classes work?
items.answer: Classes are conducted by video conference. A Join Class button appears on your dashboard when a class is available.

items.question: Can I choose my child’s teacher?
items.answer: Yes. Search and filter teachers by subject, grade, language, gender, price and availability, then view their profile before booking.

items.question: What if we can’t afford full tuition?
items.answer: You can apply for financial assistance at any time. Applications are reviewed individually and confidentially.

items.question: Is the curriculum recognized everywhere?
items.answer: Our academic programs follow recognized international standards with transparent objectives and assessment. Recognition varies by institution and country.

items.question: How are teachers verified?
items.answer: Every teacher submits qualifications, certificates and a resume for review before approval. Documents are never public.

items.question: How is Islamic content reviewed?
items.answer: Islamic courses and materials are reviewed by a qualified Islamic scholar or reviewer before publication, in addition to standard admin oversight.

assistance.title: Financial Assistance
assistance.intro: No student should be denied a quality education because their family cannot afford full tuition. Families may request a partial fee reduction or a full fee exemption. Every application is reviewed individually and confidentially by our administration team.

about.title: About Al-Noor International School
about.first: Al-Noor International School is an online international Islamic school providing internationally transferable academic and Islamic education, taught live by qualified, verified teachers to students around the world.
about.second: Our philosophy is to provide accessible, high-quality academic and Islamic education through qualified teachers, flexible online learning, internationally transferable curricula, and financial assistance for students who need it.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Have a question about enrollment, teaching, or financial assistance? Reach out to our admissions team.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.first: We collect only the information necessary to operate the platform: account details, enrollment records, class scheduling, and financial assistance details you choose to share.
privacy.second: Student contact information and financial details are never public. Teacher identification documents are visible only to authorized administrators. Parents can see only their own children's information.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body: By using this platform you agree to use it respectfully, keep your account credentials secure, and provide accurate information during registration, teacher applications, and financial assistance requests.
